stemMd:
A student has taken these notes:
- A fictional archive digitized 2,000 photographs.
- Fragile originals can be damaged by repeated handling.
- Digital copies can be viewed without touching originals.
- The archive also owns maps and letters.

The student wants to explain one preservation benefit of digitization. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The archive owns maps and letters as well as photographs.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Photographs are one category of archival material.

options.label: D
options.textMd: By allowing viewers to consult copies, digitization can reduce handling of fragile original photographs.

explanationMd: The goal asks for a mechanism, not merely a count. The keyed sentence connects consultation of copies to reduced physical handling, explaining the preservation benefit stated in the notes.

distractorRationale.a: This describes collection breadth, not a preservation benefit.
distractorRationale.b: This gives scale without explaining the benefit.
distractorRationale.c: This is too general to address preservation.
